in_marathi.name: Hrudhi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hrudhi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Hrudhi is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘hrudya’, which means 'heart' or 'mind'. This name is believed to symbolize the deep connection between the heart and mind, emphasizing the importance of emotional intelligence and inner wisdom.
